segments.an7.68:1.1: “Sattahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segments.an7.68:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaparoparaññū ca.
segments.an7.68:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
segments.an7.68:2.4: No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an7.68:2.5: suttaṃ geyyaṃ…pe… abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, nayidha ‘dhammaññū’ti vucceyya.
segments.an7.68:2.6: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammaṃ jānāti –
segments.an7.68:2.7: suttaṃ geyyaṃ…pe… abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, tasmā ‘dhammaññū’ti vuccati.
segments.an7.68:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tassa tasseva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti –
segments.an7.68:3.3: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho’ti.
segments.an7.68:3.4: No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tassa tasseva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an7.68:3.5: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho’ti, nayidha ‘atthaññū’ti vucceyya.
segments.an7.68:3.6: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tassa tasseva bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti –
segments.an7.68:3.7: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho’ti, tasmā ‘atthaññū’ti vuccati.
segments.an7.68:4.3: ‘ettakomhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenā’ti.
segments.an7.68:4.4: No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu attānaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an7.68:4.5: ‘ettakomhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenā’ti, nayidha ‘attaññū’ti vucceyya.
segments.an7.68:4.6: Yasmā ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu attānaṃ jānāti –
segments.an7.68:4.7: ‘ettakomhi saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya paṭibhānenā’ti, tasmā ‘attaññū’ti vuccati.
segments.an7.68:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mattaṃ jānāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya.
segments.an7.68:5.3: No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mattaṃ jāneyya cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya, nayidha ‘mattaññū’ti vucceyya.
segments.an7.68:5.4: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mattaṃ jānāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ paṭiggahaṇāya, tasmā ‘mattaññū’ti vuccati.
segments.an7.68:6.3: ‘ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānassā’ti.
segments.an7.68:6.4: No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an7.68:6.5: ‘ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānassā’ti, nayidha ‘kālaññū’ti vucceyya.
segments.an7.68:6.6: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālaṃ jānāti –
segments.an7.68:6.7: ‘ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa, ayaṃ kālo paṭisallānassā’ti, tasmā ‘kālaññū’ti vuccati.
segments.an7.68:6.8: Iti dhammaññū, atthaññū, attaññū, mattaññū, kālaññū.
segments.an7.68:7.3: ‘ayaṃ khattiyaparisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā, ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā.
segments.an7.68:7.4: Tattha evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ kattabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhī bhavitabba’nti.
segments.an7.68:7.5: No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisaṃ jāneyya –
segments.an7.68:7.8: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisaṃ jānāti –
segments.an7.68:7.9: ‘ayaṃ khattiyaparisā, ayaṃ brāhmaṇaparisā, ayaṃ gahapatiparisā, ayaṃ samaṇaparisā.
segments.an7.68:7.10: Tattha evaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ kattabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ, evaṃ tuṇhī bhavitabba’nti, tasmā ‘parisaññū’ti vuccati.
segments.an7.68:7.11: Iti dhammaññū, atthaññū, attaññū, mattaññū, kālaññū, parisaññū.
segments.an7.68:8.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno [sabbatthapi idha ārambhe “bhikkhuno” tveva dissati] dvayena puggalā viditā honti.
segments.an7.68:8.4: eko ariyānaṃ dassanakāmo, eko ariyānaṃ na dassanakāmo.
segments.an7.68:9.2: eko saddhammaṃ sotukāmo, eko saddhammaṃ na sotukāmo.
segments.an7.68:10.2: eko ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, eko anohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
segments.an7.68:11.2: eko sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, eko sutvā dhammaṃ na dhāreti.
segments.an7.68:11.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo sutvā na dhammaṃ dhāreti,
segments.an7.68:12.2: eko dhātānaṃ [dhatānaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati, eko dhātānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhati.
segments.an7.68:12.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo dhātānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhati,
segments.an7.68:12.5: Yvāyaṃ puggalo dhātānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati,
segments.an7.68:13.2: eko atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammappaṭipanno, eko atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya na dhammānudhammappaṭipanno.
segments.an7.68:13.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya na dhammānudhammappaṭipanno,
segments.an7.68:14.2: eko attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya, eko attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca.
segments.an7.68:14.3: Yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
segments.an7.68:14.5: Yvāyaṃ puggalo atthahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca,
segments.an7.68:15.1: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno [bhikkhunā (sī. syā.)] dvayena puggalā viditā honti.
segments.an7.68:16.2: “Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo…pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.

lines: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu puggalaparoparaññū hotīti evaṃ bhikkhu puggalānaṃ paroparaṃ tikkhamudubhāvaṃ jānanasamattho nāma hoti. 5.
Tassa tasseva suttageyyādinā bhāsitassa tadaññassa suttapadatthassa bodhakassa saddassa atthakusalatāvasena atthaṃ jānātīti atthaññū.
“Ettakomhi sīlena samādhinā paññāyā”ti evaṃ yathā attano pamāṇajānanavasena attānaṃ jānātīti attaññū.
Niddese pana paṭiggahaṇamattaññutāya eva paribhogādimattaññutā pabodhitā hotīti paṭiggahaṇamattaññutāva dassitā.
“Ayaṃ kālo uddesassa, ayaṃ kālo paripucchāya, ayaṃ kālo yogassa adhigamāyā”ti evaṃ kālaṃ jānātīti kālaññū.

Tattha pañca vassāni uddesassa kālo, dasa paripucchāya, idaṃ atisambādhaṃ, atikkhapaññassa tāvatā kālena tīretuṃ asakkuṇeyyattā dasa vassāni uddesassa kālo, vīsati paripucchāya, tato paraṃ yoge kammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
Bhikkhuparisādikaṃ catubbidhaṃ, khattiyaparisādikaṃ manussaparisaṃyeva puna catubbidhaṃ gahetvā aṭṭhavidhaṃ vadanti apare.
“Imaṃ me sevantassa akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, tasmā ayaṃ puggalo sevitabbo, vipariyāyato añño asevitabbo”ti sevitabbāsevitabbapuggalaṃ jānātīti puggalaparoparaññū.
Evañhi tesaṃ puggalānaṃ paroparaṃ ukkaṭṭhanihīnataṃ jānāti nāma.
